resources.string: The PC publishes the latest APK from a folder (start the server on the PC). The app downloads it, verifies it, then Android asks you to confirm the install.
Install the latest version from the PC
Development mode: keep listening to the PC
Asks the PC every 15 s while the app is in memory; downloads and offers the install as soon as a newer version appears.
PC unreachable or nothing published. Is the server running? Is Tailscale active on both devices?
Already up to date: the PC has nothing newer.
Verification refused: the file is not an APK of this app signed the same way.
Version %1$s ready. Android will ask you to confirm the install.
Unreadable answer from the PC or download failed.
